results.description: CITY OF MINERAL WELLS REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS RFP #2026-008 Due Date: Friday, September 18, 2026 by 2:00 p.m. CST FULLY INSURED MEDICAL, VOLUNTARY DENTAL, VOLUNTARY VISION, BASIC LIFE AD&D, VOLUNTARY LIFE & ADD, SHORT-TERM DISABILITY AND LONG TERM DISABILITY BENEFITS The City of Mineral Wells is soliciting qualifications from vendors for Fully Insured Medical, Voluntary Dental, Voluntary Vision, Basic Life & ADD, Voluntary Life & ADD, Short-term Disability, Long-Term Disability Benefits. The complete RFP packet and any subsequent Addendums may be obtained by contacting HUB International by email: gladys.reichert@hubinternational.com Responses will be received by email at Gladys Reichert gladys.reichert@hubinternational.com until 2:00 p.m. CST, Friday, September 18, 2026. Qualifications received after the deadline stated herein will not be opened and shall be considered void and unacceptable. The City of Mineral Wells reserves the right to reject any and all qualifications, to waive irregularities, and to accept the qualifications deemed the most advantageous to the City. All inquiries about this RFP shall be submitted no later than 5:00 p.m. CST Friday, August 21, 2026. All requests for information and inquiries regarding this RFP must be made, in writing to HUB International, at gladys.reichert@hubinternational.com The City is not requesting the services of a Consultant/Agent/Broker. Proposal documents can be obtained from the City of Mineral Wells's consultant/agent of record, HUB International Texas, Attn: gladys.reichert@hubinternational.com

results.description: LEGAL NOTICE PARKER COUNTY HOSPITAL DISTRICT SOLICITATION OF BIDS MEDICAL CITY DRIVE REHABILITATION The Parker County Hospital District is soliciting sealed bids for the rehabilitation of Medical City Drive, Weatherford, Texas. Bidders will be required to register at https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/pchdtx. A complete set of plans and bid documents will be located at this site. Any revisions, changes, addenda, or updates will be posted to the portal. Bids must be electronically submitted to this portal by noon on September 8th, 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted. Bids that are mailed through USPS, faxed, or hand delivered will not be accepted and returned unopened to vendors. Bids will be opened and read on Wednesday, September 9th, 2026, at 1:00 P.M. in the Parker County Hospital District Boardroom at 1130 Pecan Dr, Weatherford, Texas 76086. The Parker County Hospital District reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids and to waive any informalities or irregularities in the bid procedure or bids when such actions are deemed in the best interest of the Hospital District. Please contact Tyler Brewer at 817-341-2520 for questions or additional information or Email tyler.brewer@pchdtx.org.
